Game Overview

In mySolar, the core idea is straightforward: create and command your own solar system in mySolar, where every cosmic decision matters. Collect points to expand, engage in strategic space battles, and explore the stars. Balance resource management with tactical planning to conquer rival solars and grow your interstellar empire.

How to Play

mySolar keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Create and command your own solar system in mySolar, where every cosmic decision matters. Collect points to expand, engage in strategic space battles, and explore the stars. Balance resource management with tactical planning to conquer rival solars and grow your interstellar empire.
